Method of Attack: Ransomware attack including printing ransom notes via company printers
Using stolen files as leverage to threaten public leaks unless ransom is paid
Impacted Systems: Payroll network drives of TransLink, Coast Mountain Bus Company (CMBC), and Metro Vancouver Transit Police
Real-time GPS data, tracking, and reporting systems
Attack Vector: Network infiltration by affiliates deploying ransomware payloads
Access to restricted network drives containing sensitive employee data
